text: ياك، شلونك؟ جيتي عندنا باچر؟ هسه كلشي ماضٍ زين، بس ماكو وقت، گلتلي أمي إنو لازم تجيبين الشاي.
gloss: Hey, how are you? Are you coming to our place tomorrow? Everything is going fine, but there's no time; my mother told me that you must bring the tea.
note: written once by Qwen3.8; the same line for every attempt and renderer
